zara (sec-eng): Hey — noticed several customers in APAC reported missing RBAC changes after the OIDC client rotation last night. SCIM shows 200/204 but role updates never applied. Anyone seeing similar?

conor (infra): on it. which region/hosts? any error snippets you can paste?

zara (sec-eng): ap-southeast-1 tenants. Provisioner log from ap-southeast-1f:

```
2026-06-11T02:11:02Z provisioner[pid=721]: WARN scim/patch -> 204 tenant=orbit-corp corr=tx-ef12
2026-06-11T02:11:02Z provisioner[pid=721]: ERROR role.apply tenant=orbit-corp user=naomi@orbit err="KMS:decrypt error: key alias not found (alias/rdw/oidc/rot-20260610)" corr=tx-ef12
2026-06-11T02:11:05Z provisioner[pid=721]: INFO queued deprov id=77b3 retry=10s
```

hana (sre): interesting — OIDC client rotation updated aliases and replaced client secrets. Vault replication status?

vault-bot: Vault replication lag detected for ap-southeast-1 shard. last_sync=2026-06-11T01:58:00Z pending_replicas=2/4.

conor (infra): that would explain: bootstrap wrote new OIDC/KMS alias on hosts but secret injection failed because vault shard didn't have the secret yet. Agents boot with alias but no key id -> crypto ops fail.

zara (sec-eng): audit index shows a dip in role.grant events at 02:11. securitybot, confirm.

securitybot: Alert: audit.events.role_grant.ingest_drop triggered 2026-06-11T02:15:00Z. drop_count=28. Severity=info.

hana (sre): quick checks to run on affected node:
```
sudo cat /etc/rdw/oidc_alias || echo missing
sudo cat /etc/rdw/kms_key_id || echo missing
sudo journalctl -u rdw-bootstrap --since "2026-06-11 01:50" | tail -n 100
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:9250/metrics | grep deprov_queue
```

conor (infra): ran on 1f: oidc_alias=alias/rdw/oidc/rot-20260610, kms_key_id=""; bootstrap shows `secret lookup failed: secret not found`.

zara (sec-eng): smoking gun. Immediate remediation: (1) emergency-inject kms_key_id from primary into affected hosts (read from vault-primary snapshot), (2) restart rdw-bootstrap then provisioner, (3) drain deprov queue and replay, (4) collect evidence (provisioner logs, bootstrap logs, /etc/rdw/*) and upload to /shared/sec-incidents/1912345670/.

hana (sre): also capture correlation ids for backfill and ensure audit backfill scripts idempotently reapply role.grants. Add monitoring: agent.kms_key_id_present and audit.ingest_miss_rate for role events.

conor (infra): applying emergency inject to ap-southeast-1f now. Restarting services.

ops-bot: emergency patch applied to ap-southeast-1f. Services restarted.

hana (sre): seeing KMS:decrypt success logs and deprov queue length drop. Audit ingest rate recovering within ~50s.

zara (sec-eng): postmortem actions: block OIDC/KMS alias rotations until vault replication healthy; make bootstrap fail-fast if REDWOOD_KMS_KEY_ID missing; add rollout pre-check that validates secret presence across vault replicas; add an alert when agent.kms_key_id_present==0 for >1m. I'll own audit backfill and customer notifications.

conor (infra): opening runbook PR for safe alias rotation and bootstrap hard-fail. Assigning @conor for runbook, @hana for monitoring, @zara for audit backfill.

securitybot: Incident recorded INC-20260611-1122 severity=medium status=mitigated
